시편 2:1.content: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

시편 2:2.content: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,

시편 2:3.content: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

시편 2:4.content: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

시편 2:5.content: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

시편 2:6.content: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

시편 2:7.content: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

시편 2:8.content: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

시편 2:9.content: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

시편 2:10.content: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

시편 2:11.content: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

시편 2:12.content: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
